purpose: Frozen pointwise conversion from predictor-native scores to the common C3 usable score interval

global_policy.orientation: higher values must mean stronger support for antioxidant/AOP activity
global_policy.native_score_retention: Always retain the original native score alongside the usable score and mapping identifier
global_policy.reason: A score must map identically regardless of the other sequences in its batch; batch-wise extrema would change original-versus-perturbed differences
global_policy.unverified_predictor_policy: A documented mapping may be prepared, but it is not operationally verified until a real score is reproduced through the C3 interface
global_policy.unsupported_mapping_policy: Do not invent sigmoid, percentile, z-score, or min-max mappings without a predictor-defined or independently justified fixed contract
